steps.text: Run platform integration verify at repo root:
steps.code:
pnpm run verify
npm run verify

steps.text: Instant exit or node:sqlite error → upgrade Node to 22.13+
Port in use → change db_port in configs or DB_PORT env
Module API issues → check modulesDir and SFMC_ROOT
SQLite corruption → restore from backup after stopping services
Health check:
Check load summary and <SFMC_ROOT>/.sfmc/logs/
Run mod build; confirm esbuild has no errors
Confirm inbox conflicts are not blocking pre-start scan
Did you run mod reload or restart BDS?
Is modules/module-lock.json enabled: true?
GET /api/sfmc/modules/<id> to confirm state
Temporarily mod disable to isolate
Are dependency modules installed and enabled?
Tests must use minecraft-loader:
UnimplementedMinecraftApiError → narrow assertions or wait for sandbox depth; not a business bug
Assertion fails but BDS OK → sandbox fidelity gap; verify with Watch / live server
Author flow: testing doc
LLBot reverse WS ws://127.0.0.1:3002?
qq_group_id, llbot_* correct?
Check qq / llbot logs for connection
Firewall blocking 3002?
Build monorepo first, then module pack:
steps.code:
pnpm run build
npm run build --workspaces --if-present
sfmc> mod build

steps.text: Legacy modules importing "@sfmc/sdk" → reinstall with current CLI or fix SDK resolution
